parent.title: A Weekend in Phang Nga Anchored on Aulis

siblings.title: Dinner at Aulis, Phang Nga
siblings.summary: Simon Rogan's 15-seat Michelin-starred chef's table at Iniala Beach House, Natai Beach.

siblings.title: Where to Stay Near Aulis / Phang Nga
siblings.summary: Iniala, Aleenta and Santhiya on Natai Beach strip.

siblings.title: IT Conferences and Tech Events Near Phang Nga / Phuket
siblings.summary: One recurring Friday mixer; major IT conferences are in Bangkok.

sources.title: James Bond Island guide — Forever Vacation
sources.claim: James Bond Island is free to walk on; midday is wall-to-wall crowded.

sources.title: Phang Nga Bay guide — Phuket101
sources.claim: Bay tours 1,500–2,500 THB; premium kayak ~3,950 THB; 300 THB park entry.

sources.title: Hong by Starlight — John Gray's Sea Canoe
sources.claim: 10-hour flagship tour, ฿3,490–3,950 pp, bioluminescence after dark.

sources.title: Hidden Hong Lagoons — Andaman Sea Kayak
sources.claim: Hongs are tide-gated; only inflatable kayaks fit the entries.

sources.title: Koh Panyee — Thailand Magazine
sources.claim: 200-year-old stilted Muslim fishing village; ~400 families; floating football pitches.

sources.title: James Bond Island — Marat Nomad
sources.claim: Tours ฿1,300–2,500 pp; hotel pickup 07:00, return 17:30.

sources.title: Khao Sok fees — My Thailand Tours
sources.claim: Khao Sok foreigner entry ฿300 adult / ฿150 child, raised May 2024.

sources.title: Khao Sok 2025 — Elephant Hills
sources.claim: Nearly 400 bird species; Feb–May best wildlife window.

sources.title: Khao Sok Floating Bungalows — Passport and Stamps
sources.claim: Raft houses from $80 to $600+/night all-inclusive.

sources.title: Nam Talu Cave — Cheow Lan Lake Travel
sources.claim: 700 m cave; waist-deep wading; 2007 flash flood killed eight; closed wet season.

sources.title: Similan closure — 5 Star Marine Phuket
sources.claim: Similan closes 15 May 2026.

sources.title: Similan & Surin closure — Phuket Express
sources.claim: Both parks close mid-May to mid-October each year.

sources.title: Similan fees — Nation Thailand
sources.claim: Similan and Surin foreign entry ฿500 adult / ฿250 child.

sources.title: Day trip vs liveaboard — Go Diving
sources.claim: Richelieu Rock, Koh Bon, Koh Tachai require a liveaboard.

sources.title: Richelieu Rock — Sunrise Divers
sources.claim: Horseshoe pinnacle 40 km offshore; Thailand's #1 whale-shark site.

sources.title: Mu Ko Surin — The Captain and The Cook
sources.claim: Thailand's healthiest coral reefs; beginner-snorkel accessible.

sources.title: Police Boat 813 Memorial — Khaolak Center
sources.claim: Free memorial open 08:30–18:00 daily; boat swept 2 km inland in 2004.

sources.title: Khao Lak Beaches — Similan Dive Center
sources.claim: Nang Thong ~3 km, most popular; Bang Niang bars and night market.

sources.title: Wat Suwan Khuha — Thailand Magazine
sources.claim: 15 m reclining Buddha in limestone cave; ฿20 entry; arrive before 09:30.

sources.title: Takua Pa history — Window on Phuket
sources.claim: Sino-Portuguese shophouse streetscape from the tin-boom era; Sunday Walking Street.

sources.title: Elephant Hills official site
sources.claim: No riding; 2025 Responsible Animal Welfare Award winner.

sources.title: Phuket HKT → Khao Lak — Rome2Rio
sources.claim: ~70 km / ~1 hour; private transfer ~$35–45.
